item.text: I want to acknowledge that your idea was not properly credited during the meeting, and I’m sorry for that oversight. Your contribution was important to the direction we discussed, and I should have made that clear at the time. I will follow up with the group today to explicitly recognize that the proposal originated with you, and I will ensure your role is reflected in the meeting notes and future discussions.
